# Vendored: GSAP 3.15.0

`gsap.min.js` is GSAP 3.15.0 from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js`, unmodified, with
its licence header intact. It is inlined into every assembled page so pages open from `file://`.

Licence: Webflow's [standard "no charge" GSAP licence](https://gsap.com/standard-license). Free, including
commercial use; not OSI open source. The one prohibited use is building no-code visual animation tools
that compete with Webflow. Explainer pages are a permitted use.
